id.description: Stable slug, matches the file name without .json

street.description: Street with house number where known

district.description: Stadtteil, wie ihn die Stadt schreibt (z. B. "Bahnhofsviertel") — Grundlage der Abdeckungsanzeige in der App

openingHours.description: Free-form or OSM opening_hours syntax; omit when unknown

since.description: Year the Häuschen (or current business) opened, when documented

features.description: Merkmale — in der App die Hauptnavigation, nicht ein Filter im Untermenü

note.description: One neutral sentence of context. Facts, not marketing prose.

sources.description: Every entry names where its facts come from

verified.description: true only after a maintainer checked the sources (or the place)
